answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before its attestations count. Honest participants form an orchard whose yield compounds across epochs, while a sybil swarm finds no oasis of free entry: each fake identity needs its own fresh bond. Attestations drift between peers like a zephyr, cheap to pass, but on-ledger collusion detection slashes the colluders bonds. Forging N identities therefore costs N bonds plus the expected slash, so attack cost scales linearly with identity count while honest stake stays reclaimable.
